comments.body: 🤖 `om-open-pr` completed: customer-only fix committed as 528c3576b. Lock handed off to `om-auto-review-pr` — chain continues on this PR.
🤖 `om-auto-review-pr` taking over the chain lock — reviewing correctness, scope, tests, compatibility, and current-head checks. Lock retained for chained QA.

🏷️ `om-open-pr` label rationale

- `bug` — Restores honest occurrence-date display and ordering.
- `review` — The committed implementation is ready for review; this does not certify green validation.
- `needs-qa` — The change affects person/company activity views and requires QA approval before merge.
- `priority-medium` — Incorrect historical dates merit a normal-cycle fix.
- `risk-medium` — Customer-local logic is shared across several activity views; no API/schema changes.
- `in-progress` — The chain retains its lock through review and evidence collection, then releases it.
